scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); if (fs.existsSync('styles.css')) fs.cpSync('styles.css', 'dist/styles.css'); if (fs.existsSync('cursor.svg')) fs.cpSync('cursor.svg', 'dist/cursor.svg'); if (fs.existsSync('three.min.js')) fs.cpSync('three.min.js', 'dist/three.min.js'); if (fs.existsSync('gsap.min.js')) fs.cpSync('gsap.min.js', 'dist/gsap.min.js'); if (fs.existsSync('js')) fs.cpSync('js', 'dist/js', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('Planets')) fs.cpSync('Planets', 'dist/Planets', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('Tabs')) fs.cpSync('Tabs', 'dist/Tabs', { recursive: true }); if (fs.existsSync('Flow')) fs.cpSync('Flow', 'dist/Flow', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build complete'); })"
